_description: The source of truth for pending, active, and completed tasks.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Install Obsidian Local REST API plugin
tasks.goal: Install plugin so cron scripts can read vault notes via HTTP
tasks.context: iCloud app container is sandboxed. Install 'Local REST API' community plugin in Obsidian. Enable it, note API key and port 27124. Verify with curl http://127.0.0.1:27124/vault/. Prerequisite for fixing vault-watcher and inbox-processor crons.
tasks.recovery_note: Auto-reset from stale in_progress (6h48m) — completed on recovery attempt

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Fix vault-watcher to use REST API
tasks.goal: Rewrite obsidian_watcher.py to use curl to REST API
tasks.context: obsidian_watcher.py uses open() which fails EPERM on iCloud container. After REST API plugin installed (task 33), rewrite to curl http://127.0.0.1:27124/vault/... to list/read notes. Replace os.listdir/open with HTTP calls. Test after changes.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Fix inbox-processor to read vault notes via REST API
tasks.goal: Update cron prompt to use curl-to-REST-API for vault reads
tasks.context: Inbox processor reads pending_inbox_task.json then reads vault note. Switch from MCP to curl http://127.0.0.1:27124/vault/... Cron aa4181e6e812 runs every 5 min.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Audit all Tower data files
tasks.goal: Check every data/ file on workbench.camel-hoki.ts.net
tasks.context: SSH to Tower, check /usr/share/nginx/html/data/ for: tasks.json, task-history.json, task-templates.json, ideas-index.json, cron-status.json, system.json, logs.json, email-log.json, route-activity.json, routes.json, projects.json. Trace missing files to collector scripts and sync-workbench-data.sh.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Add missing data collectors to sync pipeline
tasks.goal: Write collector scripts for files missing from Tower data/
tasks.context: Based on audit (task 36), write or fix collectors. Follow pattern from collect-workbench-data.py. Each writes JSON to ~/.hermes/workbench-data/, sync-workbench-data.sh SCPs to Tower.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Verify queue kanban renders in Projects tab
tasks.goal: Confirm queue-panel.js renders with real data
tasks.context: Open Projects tab. Queue panel should show kanban columns with task cards. Check JS console for errors. Data source: ./data/tasks.json on Tower.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Wire real agent status from route data
tasks.goal: Replace dummy cycling statuses with actual state
tasks.context: status-panel.js cycles hardcoded statuses. Replace with data from route-activity.json: online = priority 4+ or active tasks, idle = normal, error = failing cron associations.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Responsive breakpoint test
tasks.goal: Verify all tabs at 3 viewport sizes
tasks.context: Test at 1920px, 800px (icon sidebar), 600px (no sidebar). Fix overflow and cutoff.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Console audit all 13 tabs
tasks.goal: Open every tab, fix all JS errors, reach 0 warnings
tasks.context: Open DevTools Console, click every tab. Fix all errors: missing data, null refs, selectors. Quality gate before sign-off.

tasks.title: Sprint 9 — Retrospective + production verify
tasks.goal: Document Sprint 9 and verify all tabs in production
tasks.context: Write sprint-9-retrospective.md. Cover: bugs fixed, Obsidian pipeline status, remaining issues. Deploy sync, manual tab check.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: persist message history in localStorage
tasks.goal: Save/restore chat sessions across page reloads
tasks.context: chat-panel.js already has LS_SESSIONS_KEY and LS_MSG_PREFIX constants defined but session restore may be incomplete. Ensure full round-trip: save messages per session, restore on load, switch between sessions. Follow existing ES6 module style. Use local Mistral NeMo for inline coding, DeepSeek for design review.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: model selector dropdown
tasks.goal: Add model picker in chat toolbar, fetched from /v1/models
tasks.context: Add a select dropdown to the chat toolbar. On chat render, fetch models from API_BASE + '/models'. Populate dropdown. When user sends message, pass selected model in the request body. Save preference to localStorage.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: session list sidebar
tasks.goal: Manage sessions: new, rename, delete, switch
tasks.context: Add a session sidebar to the chat tab (collapsible). Show all saved sessions from localStorage. Buttons: + New Session, rename on double-click, delete with confirm, switch on click. Active session highlighted.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: copy button + markdown polish
tasks.goal: Add copy-to-clipboard on messages, improve markdown rendering
tasks.context: Each assistant message gets a copy icon (top-right corner). Click copies message text to clipboard. Improve markdown rendering: code blocks with syntax hint, link targets, inline code styling.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Sessions tab: live viewer with auto-refresh
tasks.goal: Show active Hermes sessions, poll every 10s
tasks.context: session-inspector.js renders session cards. Add 10s auto-poll to GET /v1/sessions. Show: session ID, model, created time, last activity, message count. Auto-refresh badge. Use local coding model for JS changes, DeepSeek for API design.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Sessions: stop/cancel button
tasks.goal: Wire stop button to POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/stop
tasks.context: Each active session card gets a Stop button. On click: POST to /v1/sessions/{id}/stop. Show loading state on button. On success, update card status to 'stopped'. On error, show error inline.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Sessions: tool call timeline panel
tasks.goal: Click a session to see its tool call history
tasks.context: Click a session card → slide-in detail panel showing chronological tool calls: tool name, arguments (truncated), result summary, timestamp. Data from GET /v1/sessions/{id}/tools or synthesize from available data.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: graceful reconnection
tasks.goal: Retry on network error 3x, show connection status indicator
tasks.context: When sendMessage fails (network error, not HTTP error), retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Show a small status indicator in the toolbar: '◉ connected' green, '◉ reconnecting...' yellow, '◉ disconnected' red.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Chat: keyboard shortcuts
tasks.goal: Ctrl+Enter send, Esc cancel, Ctrl+Up edit last message
tasks.context: Implement keyboard shortcuts in the chat input: Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter to send, Esc to cancel current streaming response, Ctrl+Up (or Cmd+Up) to edit the last user message. Show shortcut hints in input placeholder.

tasks.title: Sprint 10 — Write retrospective
tasks.goal: Document Sprint 10 results
tasks.context: Write sprint-10-retrospective.md to /Volumes/Mini_1Tb/Projects/grainworks.tech/static/workflows/. Cover: shipped vs planned, LOC, key decisions, lessons learned.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Queue: inline task creation form
tasks.goal: Add a form to create tasks from the queue panel
tasks.context: queue-panel.js has an add overlay (qp-add-overlay, qp-add-form classes with CSS already added). Wire it: show form on +Add Task click, fields for title (required), goal, priority (1-5 dropdown), source. On submit, POST to /api/queue/. On success, add card to PENDING column and re-render. Use local Mistral NeMo for JS work, DeepSeek for API shape review.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Queue: batch operations
tasks.goal: Select multiple tasks, bulk change status or delete
tasks.context: queue-panel.js already has batch toggle (qp-batch-toggle) and qp-batch-check classes. Wire: toggle batch mode shows checkboxes on each card. When 1+ selected, show action bar: 'Set Pending', 'Cancel', 'Delete'. POST array of IDs to /api/queue/batch.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Queue: drag-and-drop between columns
tasks.goal: Drag cards between status columns to update task state
tasks.context: queue-panel.js has basic drag/dragstart/dragend listeners. Complete: on drop, update task status to match the target column, POST PATCH /api/queue/{id} with new status, re-render board. Add visual feedback: card opacity while dragging, highlight drop targets.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Queue: task detail overlay
tasks.goal: Click a task card to see full detail and edit fields
tasks.context: Add click handler on task cards. Opens a qp-detail overlay showing: title, goal, context, priority, source, created_at, status, completed_at. Editable fields: title, goal, priority. Save button PATCHes /api/queue/{id}. Reuse existing qp-detail-overlay and qp-detail CSS.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Cron: Run Now button
tasks.goal: Wire Run Now button to POST /api/cron/run/:id
tasks.context: cron-panel.js renders cron job cards. Add '▶ Run Now' button to each. On click: POST to /api/cron/run/{job_id}. Show spinner while running. On success: update last_run_at. On fail: show error text on card.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Cron: pause/resume toggle
tasks.goal: Toggle cron job enabled/disabled with visual state
tasks.context: Add a pause/resume toggle button on each cron card. Toggle visual: green dot = enabled, gray dot = disabled. On click: POST to /api/cron/{job_id}/pause or resume. Update card state on response.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Tower: live container status
tasks.goal: Show Tower containers with refresh and status dots
tasks.context: tower-panel.js already renders container cards from system.json (tower.containers). Add a '⟳ Refresh' button that re-fetches system.json. Container cards show: name, status dot (green=running, yellow=paused, red=stopped), image, uptime, ports.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Tower: color-coded storage bars
tasks.goal: Storage usage with color thresholds
tasks.context: tower-panel.js has tw-storage-item with tw-si-fill bar. Wire: fetch storage data from system.json (tower.share_usage or similar). Bar color: green < 70%, yellow < 90%, red > 90%. Show numeric usage text.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — SSE push endpoint for live updates
tasks.goal: Replace polling with server-sent events for real-time data
tasks.context: Create a lightweight SSE endpoint on the Tower nginx or as a Python script that watches ~/.hermes/workbench-data/ for changes and pushes updates to connected browsers. Browser tab subscribes to /events SSE stream. On new data, re-render active tab. Start simple: push on file change, 30s keepalive. Use DeepSeek for SSE architecture design, local models for implementation.

tasks.title: Sprint 11 — Write retrospective
tasks.goal: Document Sprint 11 results
tasks.context: Write sprint-11-retrospective.md. Cover: operational features shipped, SSE pipeline status, remaining gaps.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — Library: full-text search across all sources
tasks.goal: End-to-end search across 5 knowledge sources
tasks.context: library-panel.js loads from library/index.json. Ensure search works across: audiobooks, skills, fact store, contacts, ideas. Search bar filters results client-side. Facet pills filter by type. Show result count. Use local models for JS, DeepSeek for search UX design.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — Library: detail panels per type
tasks.goal: Render type-specific metadata in detail overlay
tasks.context: Library cards show different detail content per type: audiobook (author, narrator, duration), skill (author, category, description), fact (entity, trust score, source), contact (company, title, linkedin), idea (date, tags, context). Reuse lib-detail overlay CSS.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — Email tab: render real data
tasks.goal: Show real email data from email-log.json with detail
tasks.context: email-panel.js renders from data/email-log.json. Cards show: time, sender, subject, status. Click opens detail overlay with full message body. Ensure data file has real entries from the email pipeline.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — Performance: lazy-load tab modules
tasks.goal: Dynamic import JS modules on tab switch instead of all at init
tasks.context: Currently all 13 tab modules are imported eagerly at page load. Refactor to dynamic import() on tab switch. Keep frequently-used tabs (dashboard, chat, projects) eager. Lazy-load: sessions, cron, library, tower, builder. Measure initial JS load reduction. Use DeepSeek for architecture review.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — Performance: code-split large modules
tasks.goal: Split queue-panel.js (36KB) and chat-panel.js (29KB)
tasks.context: These two modules account for most of the JS payload. Extract shared utilities (relativeTime, escapeHtml) into a shared-utils.js module. Split queue-panel into board renderer + API layer + drag-drop. Split chat-panel into message renderer + API client + session manager.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — QA: full console audit v1.0
tasks.goal: Zero JS errors and warnings across all 13 tabs
tasks.context: Open every tab in browser DevTools. Capture all Console output. Fix every error: missing data files, null reference, wrong API paths, DOM selector mismatches, unhandled promise rejections. Zero warnings target. This is the v1.0 quality gate. Run on DeepSeek for thoroughness.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — QA: responsive testing
tasks.goal: All tabs usable at 1920, 800, and 600px
tasks.context: Test at 3 breakpoints. Desktop (1920px): full sidebar + content. Tablet (800px): icon-only sidebar. Mobile (600px): no sidebar, minimal padding. Fix any overflow, cutoff, or unusable elements.

tasks.title: Sprint 12 — QA: dark/light mode contrast
tasks.goal: Verify both color schemes, fix readability issues
tasks.context: Toggle prefers-color-scheme in DevTools. Check every tab surface: text contrast on panels, status dots visible, links readable, queue cards legible. Fix any inaccessible color combinations.
